The size of precipitates gradually increases from 32 ± 11.9 nm to 46.8 ± 16.9 nm with rising Ti concentration up to 2 wt%, and the number density does not evidently change, which is approximately 7.0 × 10^19 m^-3.
Almost equiaxial grains are observed in all the specimens, suggesting that recrystallization is complete.

The average grain diameter is not significantly altered up to 1 wt% Ti, whereas it decreases to 13.4 ± 2.2 μm in V-10Cr-2Ti, which is similar to the high-purity V-4Cr-2Ti alloy [7], indicating that 2 wt% Ti addition evidently retards the grain growth during annealing and results in the grain refinement.
